description: Figure 6 presents the distribution of data sources within the combined training set and the AttrEval-Simulation set. The pie chart is divided into eight slices, representing different data sources. The slice labeled “HOTPOTQA” constitutes approximately 24.67% of the chart, and is colored a shade of purple. “TRIVIAQA” represents 26.66% and is colored a shade of orange. “SCITAI” accounts for 16.43% and is colored a shade of blue. “PUBHEALTH” represents 13.33% and is colored a shade of green. “MULTINLI” accounts for 8.26% and is colored a shade of yellow. “FACTUAL” represents 5.99% and is colored a shade of red. “WEIBO” accounts for 3.69% and is colored a shade of light blue. Finally, “XSUMSUM” represents 1.85% and is colored a shade of pink. The chart includes labels for each slice indicating the data source, and percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The slices appear to be ordered in a clockwise direction, generally from largest to smallest proportion.
